newsitem.title: ITALY: Marzotto is not interested in Stefanel.
newsitem.headline: Marzotto is not interested in Stefanel.

text.p: Italian textile company Marzotto is not interested in fellow textile group Stefanel and the head of the family that controls Marzotto and its chairman, Pietro Marzotto, said he does not believe Stefanel is for sale.
"No, it has already been denied, nothing is intended," said Marzotto when asked whether his group intended to buy the struggling Stefanel group.

Marzotto was speaking after attending a meeting of Italy's employers federation Confindustria, and he added that he did not believe that Guiseppe Stefanel at the head of the Stefanel group had any intention of selling the group.
Last Saturday, Marzotto decided to walk away from a merger with the Holding Partecipazioini Industriali (HPI) which would have formed one the world's largest textile groups.
